page.overview:
Who is Tanabe?

Tanabe is an average man who normally dresses in the standard Public Safety uniform.

Tanabe is first seen at the Anti-Devil 2nd Division's Training Facility, while Reze is attacking the facility. Tanabe along with Kato are the first ones to try and stop her. Using their devil contract they grow mold inside her heart and intestines, causing internal bleeding. Reze however blows her head off and throws it into the facility, where she regenerates. Her original headless body runs at them and causes an explosion, killing him.
